data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, independently of others: individual opt-in, not unanimity. Each of the other 24: will you choose 18 ($8,000 more than 10 if fulfilled)? If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100. Risky, not guaranteed best long-run. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. State your exact intended catch and any conditions.
